systems.name: TOI-270
systems.researchSummary: TOI-270b is a cool sub-Neptune (Teq ≈ 530 K) with mass 3.2 M_E and radius 2.4 R_E orbiting a K-star every 3.35 days. First member of compact multi-planet system, TOI-270b exhibits pronounced molecular features with significant ammonia and methane across day-night terminator.
